Class Unit

java.lang.Object
models.base.Unit
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AoeUnit, BattleManagerTest.StubUnit, SingleTargetUnit, Tower, UnitTest.ConcreteUnit
public abstract class Unit extends Object implements Attackable
Abstract base class for every entity on the battlefield — cats, dogs, and towers alike.

A Unit holds core combat statistics, a sprite state machine (Unit.State), and the shared death animation logic (knockback bounce → soul float). Concrete subclasses supply their own sprites, stats, and update() AI loop.

    • update

      public abstract void update()
      Per-frame logic hook. Subclasses implement AI: movement, target acquisition, attack timing, and animation state transitions.

    • updateAnimation

      protected void updateAnimation()
      Drives the sprite state machine every frame.

      Handles three phases in priority order:

      1. DEAD_KNOCKBACK — two-bounce arc over 45 frames, then transitions to DEAD_SOUL.
      2. DEAD_SOUL — soul floats upward; sets completelyDead when it leaves the screen.
      3. Normal — cycles WALK / ATTACK / IDLE frames, triggering processAttackDamage() on animation frame 3.

    • getCurrentSprite

      public javafx.scene.image.Image getCurrentSprite()
      Returns the image to display this frame, honouring the following priority: custom override → knockback → soul → walk → attack → idle.
      Returns:
      the current sprite, or null if none is available

    • processAttackDamage

      protected void processAttackDamage()
      Applies attackDamage to all locked-in currentTargets. Called automatically by updateAnimation() on attack frame 3. The hasDealtDamageThisAttack flag prevents repeat damage within the same swing.

    • loadSharedSoulSprites

      protected void loadSharedSoulSprites()
      Lazily loads the four soul-animation frames into sharedSoulSprites if they have not been loaded yet. Safe to call from every unit constructor.
